answer.rationale: Two internal metrics (activation -6%, onboarding completion -4%) are degrading simultaneously and are directly addressed by prior successful interventions (memory_31, memory_86). Promotional pricing (memory_73) is tempting as a reaction to competitor entry pricing, but it targets price-sensitive buyers and risks attracting lower-quality, margin-eroding accounts that could undermine sustainable qualified revenue — exactly the objective we're optimizing for. I verify memory_73 to check whether the 18% revenue lift held real margin/quality, and memory_31 to confirm the onboarding simplification result is durable and not confounded, since it's the action I intend to run given it addresses two live, worsening metrics rather than reacting defensively to a competitor's pricing move. Referral and activation-messaging plays are lower urgency given they don't address the acute onboarding/activation drop, and enterprise sales-assist doesn't touch the SMB erosion. With only one experimental slot, betting on internal funnel repair (simplify_onboarding) seems more aligned with long-term qualified revenue than a reactive price cut whose downstream customer-quality effects are unverified this cycle.
